verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Marketing Emails API endpoints carry an explicit version segment (`/marketing/v3/emails`), so the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version lifecycle guarantees, which is half of the story. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and changelog documentation, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
